def fraction(value: object, name: str, upper: float = 1) -> float:
    if (
        not isinstance(value, (int, float))
        or isinstance(value, bool)
        or not math.isfinite(value)
        or not 0 <= value < upper
    ):
        raise ValueError(name + ": finite fraction required")

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class QualificationPolicy:

    achieved = 0.0
    for k in range(1, (n + 1) // 2 + 1):
        coverage = 1 - 2 * sum(math.comb(n, j) for j in range(k)) / (2**n)
        if coverage >= confidence:
            chosen, achieved = k, coverage
    return {
        "sessions": n,
        "median": median(ordered),
        "low": ordered[chosen - 1] if chosen else None,
        "high": ordered[n - chosen] if chosen else None,
        "requested_coverage": confidence,
        "achieved_coverage": achieved if chosen else None,
        "method": "binomial order-statistic interval for median of independent session effects",
    }


def assess(
    policy: QualificationPolicy,
    runs: list[Path],
    review: dict[str, object] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    grouped: dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, float]]]] = {
        case: {} for case in policy.cases
    }
    compatibility: dict[str, str] = {}
    problems: list[str] = []
    result_hashes = []
    for path in runs:
        result = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
        if (
            not isinstance(result, dict)
            or result.get("schema") != "shaderlod-comparison-result-v1"
        ):
            raise ValueError("comparison result required")
        expected = json.loads((path.parent / "receipt.json").read_bytes())
        digest = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        if expected.get("sha256") != digest:
            raise ValueError("comparison receipt mismatch")
        result_hashes.append(digest)
        if result.get("policy_sha256") != policy.identity:
            problems.append(str(path) + ": policy was not frozen before execution")
        if result.get("state") != "complete" or result.get("restored") is not True:
            problems.append(str(path) + ": failed/incomplete attempt or restoration")
        rows = result.get("observations")
        if not isinstance(rows, list):
            raise ValueError("observation list required")
        definition = json.loads((path.parent / "plan.json").read_bytes())["definition"]
        from shaderlod_host.comparison import ComparisonPlan

        plan = ComparisonPlan.decode(definition)
        if not set(policy.cases) <= {case.identity for case in plan.cases}:
            problems.append(str(path) + ": policy coverage missing from frozen plan")
        for index, row in enumerate(rows):
            if (
                not isinstance(row, dict)
                or not isinstance(row.get("case"), str)
                or not isinstance(row.get("arm"), str)
                or row.get("case") not in grouped
                or row.get("arm") not in {policy.reference, policy.candidate}
            ):
                continue
            case, arm = str(row["case"]), str(row["arm"])
            directory = path.parent / str(row["attempt"])
            verify_frame_receipt(directory / "receipt.json")
            observed = json.loads((directory / "observation.json").read_bytes())
            selected = row.get("selection")
            summary = row.get("summary")
            if (
                not isinstance(selected, dict)
                or not isinstance(summary, dict)
                or row.get("workload_valid") is not True
                or summary.get("valid") is not True
                or summary != json.loads((directory / "summary.json").read_bytes())
                or selected.get("session_identity") != observed.get("session_identity")
                or row.get("quality_only") is True
                or row.get("instrument", "frames") != "frames"
            ):
                problems.append(case + ": invalid workload or measurements")
                continue
            metadata = selected.get("session_identity")
            if not isinstance(metadata, dict) or not isinstance(
                metadata.get("child"), dict
            ):
                problems.append(case + ": missing JVM process identity")
                continue
            child = metadata["child"]
            key = json.dumps(
                [
                    metadata.get("host"),
                    metadata.get("boot"),
                    child.get("pid"),
                    child.get("birth"),
                ]
            )
            config = json.dumps(
                [
                    metadata.get("host"),
                    metadata.get("world"),
                    selected.get("surface"),
                    selected.get("dimension"),
                    selected.get("renderer"),
                    selected.get("options"),
                    selected.get("client_options"),
                    selected.get("loaded_main_class_sha256"),
                    selected.get("loaded_dev_class_sha256"),
                    next(
                        (
                            case
                            for case in definition["cases"]
                            if case["id"] == row["case"]
                        ),
                        None,
                    ),
                    observed.get("progression_clock"),
                ],
                sort_keys=True,
            )
            if case in compatibility and compatibility[case] != config:
                problems.append(
                    case + ": incompatible environments or settings; partition the case"
                )
                continue
            compatibility[case] = config
            fps = summary.get("fps")
            if (
                not isinstance(fps, (int, float))
                or isinstance(fps, bool)
                or not math.isfinite(fps)
                or fps <= 0
            ):
                problems.append(case + ": invalid throughput")
                continue
            block = str(path.resolve()) + ":" + str(row.get("block"))
            pair = grouped[case].setdefault(key, {}).setdefault(block, {})
            if arm in pair:
                raise ValueError("duplicate observation in comparison pair")
            pair[arm] = fps
    outcomes: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    family_confidence = 1 - (1 - policy.confidence) / len(policy.cases)
    for case, sessions in grouped.items():
        if len(sessions) != policy.sessions:
            problems.append(
                case + ": independent session count differs from frozen stopping rule"
            )
        effects = []
        for blocks in sessions.values():
            pairs = []
            for pair in blocks.values():
                if set(pair) != {policy.reference, policy.candidate}:
                    problems.append(case + ": missing paired arm")
                else:
                    pairs.append(pair[policy.candidate] / pair[policy.reference] - 1)
            if pairs:
                effects.append(median(pairs))
        if not effects:
            problems.append(case + ": required coverage missing")
            outcomes.append({"case": case, "state": "missing"})
            continue
        interval = median_interval(effects, family_confidence)
        low = interval["low"]
        high = interval["high"]
        threshold = (
            policy.minimum_gain
            if case in policy.benefit_cases
            else -policy.maximum_harm
        )
        state = "inconclusive"
        if isinstance(low, (int, float)) and low >= threshold:
            state = "meets_margin"
        elif isinstance(high, (int, float)) and high < threshold:
            state = "fails_margin"
        outcomes.append(
            {
                "case": case,
                "state": state,
                "margin": threshold,
                "session_effects": effects,
                "interval": interval,
            }
        )
    quality = False
    if review is not None:
        record = object_fields(
            review,
            {
                "schema",
                "reviewer",
                "date",
                "policy_sha256",
                "results_sha256",
                "cases",
                "approved",
                "limitations",
            },
            "quality review",
        )
        for key in ("results_sha256", "cases"):
            items = record[key]
            if not isinstance(items, list) or not all(
                isinstance(item, str) for item in items
            ):
                raise ValueError("quality review requires string identities")
        quality = (
            record["schema"] == "shaderlod-quality-review-v1"
            and record["approved"] is True
            and bool(label(record["reviewer"], "reviewer"))
            and bool(label(record["date"], "date"))
            and record["policy_sha256"] == policy.identity
            and isinstance(record["results_sha256"], list)
            and set(result_hashes) <= set(record["results_sha256"])
            and isinstance(record["cases"], list)
            and set(policy.cases) <= set(record["cases"])
        )
    return {
        "schema": "shaderlod-qualification-assessment-v1",
        "policy_sha256": policy.identity,
        "cases": outcomes,
        "problems": problems,
        "quality_review_complete": quality,
        "recommendation": "meets_declared_policy"
        if quality
        and not problems
        and all(case["state"] == "meets_margin" for case in outcomes)
        else "do_not_promote",
        "limits": "Conditional on independent comparable sessions and declared coverage; no universal hardware/pack or perceptual claim; small samples remain inconclusive",
    }

def executable_inputs(
    launch: dict[str, object], root: Path, profile: Path | None = None
) -> dict[str, str]:
    paths: set[Path] = set()
    pending = list(launch["argv"]) if isinstance(launch["argv"], list) else []
    visited: set[str] = set()
    while pending:
        token = str(pending.pop())
        if token.startswith("@") and token not in visited:
            visited.add(token)
            path = Path(token[1:])
            paths.add(path)
            pending.extend(shlex.split(path.read_text(), comments=True))
        else:
            for piece in token.split(os.pathsep):
                path = Path(piece)
                if path.is_absolute() and path.is_file():
                    paths.add(path)
    legacy = root / "build/moddev/developmentLegacyClasspath.txt"
    paths.add(legacy)
    paths.update(Path(line) for line in legacy.read_text().splitlines() if line)
    paths.update((root / "shaderlod_host").glob("*.py"))
    if profile is not None:
        paths.update((profile / "mods").glob("*.jar"))
    for directory in [
        root / "build/classes/java",
        root / "build/resources",
        root / "dependencies/runtime",
    ]:
        paths.update(path for path in directory.rglob("*") if path.is_file())
    return {
        str(path): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        for path in sorted(paths)
        if path.is_file()
    }


PROBE_OUTPUTS = (
    "shaderlod-functional.json",
    "shaderlod-functional.png",
    "shaderlod-functional-identity.png",
)


def preserve_outputs(profile: Path, destination: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    preserved: dict[str, str] = {}
    for name in PROBE_OUTPUTS:
        source = profile / name
        if source.is_file():
            destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            preserved[name] = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            shutil.move(source, destination / name)
    return preserved


def read_functional(path: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, object] | None, str | None]:
    try:
        observed = json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else None
        if observed is not None and not isinstance(observed, dict):
            raise ValueError("functional output must be an object")
        return observed, None
    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
        return None, str(error)


def attempt_receipt(requested: Path | None, repository: Path, mode: str) -> Path:
    if requested is None:
        stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", time.gmtime())
        requested = evidence_root() / "attempts" / f"{stamp}-{mode}.json"
    resolved = requested.resolve()
    if resolved.is_relative_to(repository.resolve()):
        raise ValueError(
            "receipts belong outside the repository; omit --receipt to use "
            + str(evidence_root() / "attempts")
        )
    if resolved.exists() or resolved.with_suffix("").exists():
        raise ValueError("receipt already exists; choose a new --receipt or omit it")
    resolved.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return resolved


def benchmark_session(
    launch_path: Path,
    profile: Path,
    display: Path,
    session: Path,
    ownership: Path,
    timeout: int,
    world: str = "ShaderLOD-Smoke",
) -> int:
    if sys.platform not in {"linux", "win32"} or not 1 <= timeout <= 14400:
        raise ValueError("Linux/Windows session with 1–14400 second deadline required")
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    if session.exists() or session.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError("fresh external session directory required")
    if not world or world in {".", ".."} or "/" in world or "\\" in world:
        raise ValueError("single prepared world name required")
    if not profile.is_dir() or not (profile / "saves" / world).is_dir():
        raise ValueError("prepared profile and selected world required")
    launch = json.loads(launch_path.read_bytes())
    if not isinstance(launch.get("argv"), list) or not all(
        isinstance(a, str) for a in launch["argv"]
    ):
        raise ValueError("invalid launch argv")
    argv = list(launch["argv"])
    if "-cp" not in argv:
        raise ValueError("explicit classpath launch required")
    position = argv.index("-cp")
    argv[position:position] = [
        "-Dshaderlod.functionalProbe=false",
        "-Dshaderlod.benchmarkDirectory=" + str(session.resolve()),
    ]
    profile = profile.resolve(strict=True)
    shipping = Path(launch["shipping_jar"])
    import zipfile

    with zipfile.ZipFile(shipping) as archive:
        for compiled in (root / "build/classes/java/main").rglob("*.class"):
            member = compiled.relative_to(root / "build/classes/java/main").as_posix()
            if archive.read(member) != compiled.read_bytes():
                raise ValueError(
                    "shipping JAR differs from compiled sources; build jar before opening session"
                )
    environment = (
        worker_environment() if os.name == "nt" else display_environment(display)
    )
    environment.update(launch["environment"])
    with BusyRefusal(ownership, socket.gethostname() + ":gpu:0"):
        session.mkdir(parents=True)
        found_world = False
        for index, token in enumerate(argv):
            if token.startswith("@"):
                args = shlex.split(Path(token[1:]).read_text(), comments=True)
                if "--quickPlaySingleplayer" in args:
                    position = args.index("--quickPlaySingleplayer") + 1
                    if position >= len(args):
                        raise ValueError("missing quick-play world argument")
                    args[position] = world
                    from shaderlod_host.storage import publish_bytes

                    frozen = session / "world-program-args.txt"
                    publish_bytes(
                        frozen,
                        (
                            "\n".join(
                                '"' + a.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"') + '"'
                                for a in args
                            )
                            + "\n"
                        ).encode(),
                    )
                    argv[index] = "@" + str(frozen)
                    found_world = True
        if not found_world:
            raise ValueError("launch must declare one quick-play world")
        launch = dict(launch, argv=argv)
        publish(session / "launch.json", launch)
        launch_path = session / "launch.json"
        with profile_artifact(profile, shipping, session):
            before = executable_inputs(launch, root, profile)
            with (session / "client.log").open("xb") as log:
                worker = subprocess.Popen(
                    [
                        sys.executable,
                        "-m",
                        "shaderlod_host.worker",
                        str(time.monotonic() + timeout),
                        str(os.getpid()),
                        birth(os.getpid()),
                        json.dumps(argv),
                        str(session / "child.json"),
                        "session",
                    ],
                    cwd=profile,
                    env=worker_environment(environment),
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                )
                publish(
                    session / "session.json",
                    {
                        "schema": "shaderlod-session-v1",
                        "host": socket.gethostname(),
                        "boot": boot(),
                        "owner_pid": os.getpid(),
                        "owner_birth": birth(os.getpid()),
                        "profile": str(profile.resolve()),
                        "world": world,
                        "launch": str(launch_path.resolve()),
                        "executable_inputs": before,
                        "timeout_seconds": timeout,
                        "capabilities": [
                            "status",
                            "capture",
                            "select",
                            "restore",
                            "prepare",
                            "screenshot",
                            "close",
                        ],
                        "qualification": "unqualified development session",
                        "child_record": str(session / "child.json"),
                    },
                )
                try:
                    telemetry_stop = threading.Event()
                    telemetry_errors: list[str] = []
                    telemetry = threading.Thread(
                        target=record_telemetry,
                        args=(session, telemetry_stop, telemetry_errors),
                        daemon=True,
                    )
                    telemetry.start()
                    try:
                        status = worker.wait(timeout=timeout + 5)
                    finally:
                        telemetry_stop.set()
                        telemetry.join(timeout=3)
                finally:
                    if worker.poll() is None:
                        worker.terminate()
                        worker.wait(timeout=3)
                unchanged = before == executable_inputs(launch, root, profile)
        publish(
            session / "closed.json",
            {
                "schema": "shaderlod-session-close-v1",
                "returncode": status,
                "inputs_unchanged": unchanged,
                "profile_artifact_restored": True,
                "telemetry_errors": telemetry_errors,
                "telemetry_stopped": not telemetry.is_alive(),
                "restoration": "profile artifact restored; shader/world state is established by acknowledged close and recovery journals",
                "shader_recovery_pending": (
                    profile / "shaderlod-recovery.json"
                ).exists(),
                "world_recovery_pending": (
                    profile / "shaderlod-benchmark-world.json"
                ).exists(),
            },
        )
        return status


def record_telemetry(
    session: Path, stopping: threading.Event, errors: list[str]
) -> None:
    from shaderlod_host.telemetry import NvidiaSensors, host_sample

    sensors = NvidiaSensors()
    started = time.monotonic_ns()
    index = 0
    try:
        while not stopping.is_set():
            index += 1
            record = host_sample()
            record["schema"] = "shaderlod-telemetry-v1"
            record["elapsed_ns"] = time.monotonic_ns() - started
            record["unix_ns"] = time.time_ns()
            record["gpu"] = sensors.sample()
            publish(session / "telemetry" / (str(index) + ".json"), record)
            stopping.wait(1)
    except (OSError, ValueError, AttributeError) as error:
        errors.append(str(error))
    finally:
        sensors.close()

def execute_campaign(
    campaign: object,
    launch: Path,
    profile: Path,
    display: Path,
    ownership: Path,
    output: Path,
    world: str,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    from shaderlod_host.assessment import assess
    from shaderlod_host.benchmark import session_command, wait_ready
    from shaderlod_host.campaign import Campaign
    from shaderlod_host.comparison import execute_comparison

    if not isinstance(campaign, Campaign) or output.exists():
        raise ValueError("decoded campaign and fresh output required")
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    publish(output / "campaign.json", campaign.wire())
    deadline = time.monotonic() + campaign.budget_ms / 1000
    runs = []
    failures = []
    for index, comparison in enumerate(campaign.comparisons):
        session = output / ("session-" + str(index + 1))
        allowance = (campaign.startup_ms + comparison.budget_ms) / 1000 + 15
        if time.monotonic() + allowance > deadline:
            failures.append(
                {
                    "session": index + 1,
                    "failure": "remaining campaign budget cannot admit complete planned session",
                }
            )
            break
        argv = [
            sys.executable,
            "-m",
            "shaderlod_host",
            "session-open",
            "--launch",
            str(launch.resolve()),
            "--profile",
            str(profile.resolve()),
            "--display",
            str(display.resolve()),
            "--ownership-root",
            str(ownership.resolve()),
            "--session",
            str(session.resolve()),
            "--timeout",
            str(int(allowance)),
            "--world",
            world,
        ]
        with (output / ("launcher-" + str(index + 1) + ".log")).open("xb") as log:
            owner = subprocess.Popen(
                argv,
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stdout=log,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                env=worker_environment(),
            )
            try:
                ready_deadline = time.monotonic() + campaign.startup_ms / 1000
                while not (session / "session.json").exists():
                    if owner.poll() is not None or time.monotonic() >= ready_deadline:
                        raise ValueError(
                            "session startup failed or exhausted its fixed allowance"
                        )
                    time.sleep(0.05)
                wait_ready(session, max(0.1, ready_deadline - time.monotonic()))
                run = output / ("comparison-" + str(index + 1))
                result = execute_comparison(
                    comparison, session, run, policy=campaign.policy.wire()
                )
                runs.append(run / "result.json")
                if result["state"] != "complete":
                    raise ValueError(
                        "planned comparison incomplete; no automatic retry"
                    )
            except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
                failures.append({"session": index + 1, "failure": str(error)})
            finally:
                if owner.poll() is None:
                    try:
                        session_command(
                            session,
                            "close",
                            0,
                            min(15, max(0.1, deadline - time.monotonic())),
                        )
                    except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
                        failures.append(
                            {"session": index + 1, "close_failure": str(error)}
                        )
                        owner.terminate()
                try:
                    owner.wait(timeout=5)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    owner.kill()
                    owner.wait(timeout=3)
                    failures.append(
                        {
                            "session": index + 1,
                            "close_failure": "supervisor forced down; inspect recovery journals",
                        }
                    )
            if failures:
                break
    assessment = assess(campaign.policy, runs) if runs else None
    result = {
        "schema": "shaderlod-campaign-result-v1",
        "state": "complete"
        if len(runs) == len(campaign.comparisons) and not failures
        else "incomplete",
        "runs": [str(path.relative_to(output)) for path in runs],
        "failures": failures,
        "assessment": assessment,
        "quality": "required separately; no automatic acceptance",
    }
    publish(output / "result.json", result)
    return result


def freeze_windows_runtime(legacy: Path, output: Path, root: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    from shaderlod_host.storage import publish_bytes, replace_bytes

    if os.name != "nt" or output.exists() or output.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError("fresh external native Windows runtime destination required")
    manifest_path = root / "build/moddev/windows-launch.json"
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_bytes())
    legacy = legacy.resolve(strict=True)
    argv = list(manifest["argv"])
    old_classpath = (root / "build/moddev/developmentLegacyClasspath.txt").read_text()
    sources = {Path(item) for item in argv[argv.index("-cp") + 1].split(os.pathsep)}
    sources.update(Path(item) for item in old_classpath.splitlines() if item)
    copied = {}
    total = sum(
        p.stat().st_size for p in sources if p.is_file() and p.is_relative_to(legacy)
    )
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if shutil.disk_usage(output.parent).free < total + 1073741824:
        raise ValueError("insufficient capacity for runtime snapshot and reserve")
    output.mkdir()
    for path in sorted(sources):
        if path.is_relative_to(legacy):
            target = output / path.relative_to(legacy)
            payload = path.read_bytes()
            publish_bytes(target, payload)
            copied[str(target)] = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()

    def relocated(text: str) -> str:
        return text.replace(str(legacy), str(output)).replace(
            legacy.as_posix(), output.as_posix()
        )

    argv[argv.index("-cp") + 1] = relocated(argv[argv.index("-cp") + 1])
    vm = next(Path(item[1:]) for item in argv if item.startswith("@"))
    base_vm = vm.read_text().split("# User JVM Arguments")[0]
    logging = legacy / "build/moddev/clientLodOnLog4j2.xml"
    publish_bytes(output / "logging.xml", logging.read_bytes())
    new_vm = output / "vm-args.txt"
    entries = [
        base_vm,
        "-Xmx6G",
        "-Dlog4j2.configurationFile=" + str(output / "logging.xml"),
        "-Djava.net.preferIPv6Addresses=system",
        "-DignoreList=mixinextras-neoforge-0.5.3.jar,client-extra,neoforge-",
        "-DlegacyClassPath.file="
        + str(root / "build/moddev/developmentLegacyClasspath.txt"),
    ]
    publish_bytes(new_vm, ("\n".join(entries) + "\n").encode())
    argv[argv.index("@" + str(vm))] = "@" + str(new_vm)
    manifest["argv"] = argv
    manifest["runtime_snapshot"] = str(output)
    serialized = json.dumps(manifest, sort_keys=True).encode()
    if (
        str(legacy).encode() in serialized
        or str(legacy).encode() in new_vm.read_bytes()
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "source checkout dependency remains; snapshot preserved without changing launch"
        )
    publish_bytes(output / "previous-launch.json", manifest_path.read_bytes())
    publish_bytes(output / "previous-legacy-classpath.txt", old_classpath.encode())
    replace_bytes(
        root / "build/moddev/developmentLegacyClasspath.txt",
        relocated(old_classpath).encode(),
    )
    replace_bytes(manifest_path, serialized)
    record: dict[str, object] = {
        "schema": "shaderlod-windows-runtime-snapshot-v1",
        "files": copied,
        "copied_bytes": total,
        "runtime": str(output),
        "launch_sha256": hashlib.sha256(serialized).hexdigest(),
        "shared_dependencies": "Existing user-owned toolchain and Gradle artifact cache outside the original source checkout remain referenced",
    }
    publish(output / "manifest.json", record)
    return record

def boot() -> str:
    if os.name == "nt":
        import winreg

        with getattr(winreg, "OpenKey")(
            getattr(winreg, "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE"),
            r"SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management\PrefetchParameters",
        ) as key:
            value, _ = getattr(winreg, "QueryValueEx")(key, "BootId")
            return str(value)
    return Path("/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id").read_text().strip()


def birth(pid: int) -> str:
    if os.name == "nt":
        kernel = getattr(ctypes, "WinDLL")("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
        kernel.OpenProcess.argtypes = [wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.BOOL, wintypes.DWORD]
        kernel.OpenProcess.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
        kernel.GetProcessTimes.argtypes = [
            wintypes.HANDLE,
            ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.FILETIME),
            ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.FILETIME),
            ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.FILETIME),
            ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.FILETIME),
        ]
        kernel.CloseHandle.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE]
        handle = kernel.OpenProcess(0x1000, False, pid)
        if not handle:
            raise ProcessLookupError("process identity unavailable")
        times = [wintypes.FILETIME() for _ in range(4)]
        try:
            if not kernel.GetProcessTimes(handle, *[ctypes.byref(t) for t in times]):
                raise ProcessLookupError("process times unavailable")
            return str((times[0].dwHighDateTime << 32) | times[0].dwLowDateTime)
        finally:
            kernel.CloseHandle(handle)
    value = Path(f"/proc/{pid}/stat").read_text()
    return value[value.rfind(")") + 2 :].split()[19]


class WindowsJob:
    def __init__(self, pid: int) -> None:
        class Basic(ctypes.Structure):
            _fields_ = [
                ("process_time", ctypes.c_longlong),
                ("job_time", ctypes.c_longlong),
                ("flags", wintypes.DWORD),
                ("min_working_set", ctypes.c_size_t),
                ("max_working_set", ctypes.c_size_t),
                ("active_processes", wintypes.DWORD),
                ("affinity", ctypes.c_size_t),
                ("priority", wintypes.DWORD),
                ("scheduling", wintypes.DWORD),
            ]

        class Extended(ctypes.Structure):
            _fields_ = [
                ("basic", Basic),
                ("io_counters", ctypes.c_ulonglong * 6),
                ("process_memory", ctypes.c_size_t),
                ("job_memory", ctypes.c_size_t),
                ("peak_process_memory", ctypes.c_size_t),
                ("peak_job_memory", ctypes.c_size_t),
            ]

        self.kernel = getattr(ctypes, "WinDLL")("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
        self.kernel.CreateJobObjectW.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, wintypes.LPCWSTR]
        self.kernel.CreateJobObjectW.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
        self.kernel.SetInformationJobObject.argtypes = [
            wintypes.HANDLE,
            ctypes.c_int,
            ctypes.c_void_p,
            wintypes.DWORD,
        ]
        self.kernel.AssignProcessToJobObject.argtypes = [
            wintypes.HANDLE,
            wintypes.HANDLE,
        ]
        self.kernel.TerminateJobObject.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, wintypes.UINT]
        self.kernel.CloseHandle.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE]
        self.kernel.OpenProcess.argtypes = [
            wintypes.DWORD,
            wintypes.BOOL,
            wintypes.DWORD,
        ]
        self.kernel.OpenProcess.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
        self.handle = self.kernel.CreateJobObjectW(None, None)
        if not self.handle:
            raise OSError("cannot create owned Windows job")
        process = self.kernel.OpenProcess(0x0101, False, pid)
        limits = Extended()
        limits.basic.flags = 0x2000
        try:
            if (
                not process
                or not self.kernel.SetInformationJobObject(
                    self.handle, 9, ctypes.byref(limits), ctypes.sizeof(limits)
                )
                or not self.kernel.AssignProcessToJobObject(self.handle, process)
            ):
                raise OSError("cannot attach child to kill-on-close Windows job")
        except OSError:
            self.kernel.CloseHandle(self.handle)
            raise
        finally:
            if process:
                self.kernel.CloseHandle(process)

    def stop(self) -> None:
        self.kernel.TerminateJobObject(self.handle, 124)
        self.kernel.CloseHandle(self.handle)


def main() -> int:
    if sys.platform not in {"linux", "win32"}:
        return 125
    deadline = float(sys.argv[1])
    parent_pid = int(sys.argv[2])
    parent_birth = sys.argv[3]
    argv = json.loads(sys.argv[4])
    stopping = False

    def stop(signum: int, frame: object) -> None:
        nonlocal stopping
        stopping = True

    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, stop)
    child = subprocess.Popen(
        argv,
        start_new_session=True,
        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        stdout=None,
        stderr=None,
    )
    exitcode = 124
    job = None
    if os.name == "nt":
        try:
            job = WindowsJob(child.pid)
        except OSError:
            child.kill()
            child.wait(timeout=3)
            raise
    try:
        if len(sys.argv) == 7:
            destination = Path(sys.argv[5])
            record = {
                "schema": "shaderlod-child-v1",
                "request": sys.argv[6],
                "host": socket.gethostname(),
                "boot": boot(),
                "pid": child.pid,
                "birth": birth(child.pid),
            }
            publish(destination, record)
        while True:
            if os.name == "nt":
                windows_status = child.poll()
                if windows_status is not None:
                    exitcode = windows_status
                    break
                status = None
            else:
                status = os.waitid(
                    os.P_PID, child.pid, os.WEXITED | os.WNOHANG | os.WNOWAIT
                )
            if status is not None:
                exitcode = (
                    status.si_status
                    if status.si_code == os.CLD_EXITED
                    else 128 + status.si_status
                )
                break
            try:
                parent_alive = birth(parent_pid) == parent_birth
            except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError):
                parent_alive = False
            if stopping or not parent_alive or time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                break
            time.sleep(0.005)
    finally:
        if job is not None:
            job.stop()
        else:
            try:
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            except ProcessLookupError:
                pass
        child.wait(timeout=1)
    return exitcode


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())


def probe_worker(output: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError("fresh watchdog probe directory required")
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    observations = []
    for name, child_code, parent_identity, seconds, expected in [
        ("normal", "pass", birth(os.getpid()), 5, 0),
        ("deadline", "import time; time.sleep(20)", birth(os.getpid()), 0.3, 124),
        ("parent-loss", "import time; time.sleep(20)", "invalid-parent-birth", 5, 124),
    ]:
        record = output / (name + "-child.json")
        started = time.monotonic()
        run = subprocess.run(
            [
                sys.executable,
                "-m",
                "shaderlod_host.worker",
                str(started + seconds),
                str(os.getpid()),
                parent_identity,
                json.dumps([sys.executable, "-c", child_code]),
                str(record),
                name,
            ],
            capture_output=True,
            timeout=10,
        )
        quiescent = True
        if record.exists():
            child = json.loads(record.read_bytes())
            try:
                quiescent = birth(child["pid"]) != child["birth"]
            except (OSError, ValueError, ProcessLookupError):
                quiescent = True
        else:
            quiescent = False
        observed = {
            "case": name,
            "returncode": run.returncode,
            "expected": expected,
            "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
            "child_quiescent": quiescent,
            "stderr": run.stderr.decode(errors="replace"),
            "pass": run.returncode == expected and quiescent,
        }
        observations.append(observed)
        publish(output / (name + ".json"), observed)
    result: dict[str, object] = {
        "schema": "shaderlod-watchdog-probe-v1",
        "platform": sys.platform,
        "boot": boot(),
        "observations": observations,
        "pass": all(o["pass"] for o in observations),
    }
    publish(output / "result.json", result)
    return result

                )
            )

        if args.output_root is None or args.ownership_root is None:

        result = execute(
            request,

            args.output_root,
            args.ownership_root,
            args.control,
            args.reserve_bytes,
        )
        print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
        return 0 if result["state"] == "complete" else 1
    except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
        print(json.dumps({"status": "refused", "reason": str(error)}))
        return 2

from dataclasses import dataclass
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median

from shaderlod_host.benchmark import (
    label,
    object_fields,
    positive,
    verify_frame_receipt,
    build_identity,
)


def fraction(value: object, name: str, upper: float = 1) -> float:
    if (
        not isinstance(value, (int, float))
        or isinstance(value, bool)
        or not 0 <= value < upper
        or not math.isfinite(value)
    ):
        raise ValueError(name + ": finite fraction required")
    return float(value)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class QualificationPolicy:
    reference: str
    candidate: str
    confidence: float
    minimum_gain: float
    maximum_harm: float
    cases: tuple[str, ...]
    benefit_cases: tuple[str, ...]
    sessions: int
    quality_criteria: str

    @classmethod
    def decode(cls, value: object) -> "QualificationPolicy":
        data = object_fields(
            value,
            {
                "schema",
                "reference",
                "candidate",
                "confidence",
                "minimum_gain",
                "maximum_harm",
                "cases",
                "benefit_cases",
                "sessions",
                "quality_criteria",
            },
            "qualification policy",
        )
        if data["schema"] != "shaderlod-qualification-policy-v1":
            raise ValueError("unsupported policy")
        if (
            not isinstance(data["cases"], list)
            or not 1 <= len(data["cases"]) <= 64
            or not isinstance(data["benefit_cases"], list)
            or not data["benefit_cases"]
        ):
            raise ValueError("required cases and benefit cases must be explicit")
        cases = tuple(label(c, "case") for c in data["cases"])
        benefits = tuple(label(c, "benefit case") for c in data["benefit_cases"])
        if (
            len(set(cases)) != len(cases)
            or len(set(benefits)) != len(benefits)
            or not set(benefits) <= set(cases)
        ):
            raise ValueError("distinct cases and matching benefit scope required")
        confidence = fraction(data["confidence"], "confidence")
        reference, candidate = (
            label(data["reference"], "reference"),
            label(data["candidate"], "candidate"),
        )
        if reference == candidate or confidence < 0.8:
            raise ValueError("distinct arms and confidence of at least 0.8 required")
        sessions = positive(data["sessions"], "sessions")
        if sessions > 128:
            raise ValueError("bounded fixed session count required")
        return cls(
            reference,
            candidate,
            confidence,
            fraction(data["minimum_gain"], "minimum_gain"),
            fraction(data["maximum_harm"], "maximum_harm"),
            cases,
            benefits,
            sessions,
            label(data["quality_criteria"], "quality_criteria"),
        )

    def wire(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "schema": "shaderlod-qualification-policy-v1",
            "reference": self.reference,
            "candidate": self.candidate,
            "confidence": self.confidence,
            "minimum_gain": self.minimum_gain,
            "maximum_harm": self.maximum_harm,
            "cases": list(self.cases),
            "benefit_cases": list(self.benefit_cases),
            "sessions": self.sessions,
            "quality_criteria": self.quality_criteria,
        }

    @property
    def identity(self) -> str:
        return hashlib.sha256(
            json.dumps(self.wire(), sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False).encode()
        ).hexdigest()


def median_interval(values: list[float], confidence: float) -> dict[str, object]:
    if (
        not values
        or any(not math.isfinite(v) for v in values)
        or not 0 < confidence < 1
    ):
        raise ValueError("finite independent observations and confidence required")
    ordered = sorted(values)
    n = len(ordered)
    chosen = 0
    achieved = 0.0
    for k in range(1, (n + 1) // 2 + 1):
        coverage = 1 - 2 * sum(math.comb(n, j) for j in range(k)) / (2**n)
        if coverage >= confidence:
            chosen, achieved = k, coverage
    return {
        "sessions": n,
        "median": median(ordered),
        "low": ordered[chosen - 1] if chosen else None,
        "high": ordered[n - chosen] if chosen else None,
        "requested_coverage": confidence,
        "achieved_coverage": achieved if chosen else None,
        "method": "binomial order-statistic interval for median of independent session effects",
    }


def assess(
    policy: QualificationPolicy,
    runs: list[Path],
    review: dict[str, object] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    grouped: dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, float]]]] = {
        case: {} for case in policy.cases
    }
    compatibility: dict[str, str] = {}
    problems: list[str] = []
    result_hashes = []
    for path in runs:
        from shaderlod_host.comparison import verify_comparison

        result = verify_comparison(path)
        if (
            not isinstance(result, dict)
            or result.get("schema") != "shaderlod-comparison-result-v1"
        ):
            raise ValueError("comparison result required")
        expected = json.loads((path.parent / "receipt.json").read_bytes())
        digest = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        if expected.get("sha256") != digest:
            raise ValueError("comparison receipt mismatch")
        result_hashes.append(digest)
        if result.get("policy_sha256") != policy.identity:
            problems.append(str(path) + ": policy was not frozen before execution")
        if result.get("state") != "complete" or result.get("restored") is not True:
            problems.append(str(path) + ": failed/incomplete attempt or restoration")
        rows = result.get("observations")
        if not isinstance(rows, list):
            raise ValueError("observation list required")
        definition = json.loads((path.parent / "plan.json").read_bytes())["definition"]
        from shaderlod_host.comparison import ComparisonPlan

        plan = ComparisonPlan.decode(definition)
        if not set(policy.cases) <= {case.identity for case in plan.cases}:
            problems.append(str(path) + ": policy coverage missing from frozen plan")
        for index, row in enumerate(rows):
            if (
                not isinstance(row, dict)
                or not isinstance(row.get("case"), str)
                or not isinstance(row.get("arm"), str)
                or row.get("case") not in grouped
                or row.get("arm") not in {policy.reference, policy.candidate}
            ):
                continue
            case, arm = str(row["case"]), str(row["arm"])
            directory = path.parent / str(row["attempt"])
            verify_frame_receipt(directory / "receipt.json")
            observed = json.loads((directory / "observation.json").read_bytes())
            selected = row.get("selection")
            summary = row.get("summary")
            if (
                not isinstance(selected, dict)
                or not isinstance(summary, dict)
                or row.get("workload_valid") is not True
                or summary.get("valid") is not True
                or summary != json.loads((directory / "summary.json").read_bytes())
                or selected.get("session_identity") != observed.get("session_identity")
                or row.get("quality_only") is True
                or row.get("instrument", "frames") != "frames"
            ):
                problems.append(case + ": invalid workload or measurements")
                continue
            metadata = selected.get("session_identity")
            if not isinstance(metadata, dict) or not isinstance(
                metadata.get("child"), dict
            ):
                problems.append(case + ": missing JVM process identity")
                continue
            candidate_build = build_identity(metadata)
            if candidate_build is None:
                problems.append(case + ": missing exact candidate build identity")
                continue
            child = metadata["child"]
            key = json.dumps(
                [
                    metadata.get("host"),
                    metadata.get("boot"),
                    child.get("pid"),
                    child.get("birth"),
                ]
            )
            config = json.dumps(
                [
                    metadata.get("host"),
                    metadata.get("world"),
                    candidate_build,
                    metadata.get("instrumentation"),
                    selected.get("surface"),
                    selected.get("dimension"),
                    selected.get("renderer"),
                    selected.get("runtime"),
                    selected.get("runtime_mods"),
                    selected.get("world_seed"),
                    selected.get("world_path"),
                    selected.get("resource_packs"),
                    selected.get("dh", {}).get("present"),
                    selected.get("dh", {}).get("enabled"),
                    selected.get("dh", {}).get("version"),
                    selected.get("options"),
                    selected.get("client_options"),
                    selected.get("loaded_main_class_sha256"),
                    selected.get("loaded_dev_class_sha256"),
                    next(
                        (
                            case
                            for case in definition["cases"]
                            if case["id"] == row["case"]
                        ),
                        None,
                    ),
                    observed.get("progression_clock"),
                ],
                sort_keys=True,
            )
            if case in compatibility and compatibility[case] != config:
                problems.append(
                    case + ": incompatible environments or settings; partition the case"
                )
                continue
            compatibility[case] = config
            fps = summary.get("fps")
            if (
                not isinstance(fps, (int, float))
                or isinstance(fps, bool)
                or not math.isfinite(fps)
                or fps <= 0
            ):
                problems.append(case + ": invalid throughput")
                continue
            block = str(path.resolve()) + ":" + str(row.get("block"))
            pair = grouped[case].setdefault(key, {}).setdefault(block, {})
            if arm in pair:
                raise ValueError("duplicate observation in comparison pair")
            pair[arm] = fps
    outcomes: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    family_confidence = 1 - (1 - policy.confidence) / len(policy.cases)
    for case, sessions in grouped.items():
        if len(sessions) != policy.sessions:
            problems.append(
                case + ": independent session count differs from frozen stopping rule"
            )
        effects = []
        for blocks in sessions.values():
            pairs = []
            for pair in blocks.values():
                if set(pair) != {policy.reference, policy.candidate}:
                    problems.append(case + ": missing paired arm")
                else:
                    pairs.append(pair[policy.candidate] / pair[policy.reference] - 1)
            if pairs:
                effects.append(median(pairs))
        if not effects:
            problems.append(case + ": required coverage missing")
            outcomes.append({"case": case, "state": "missing"})
            continue
        interval = median_interval(effects, family_confidence)
        low = interval["low"]
        high = interval["high"]
        threshold = (
            policy.minimum_gain
            if case in policy.benefit_cases
            else -policy.maximum_harm
        )
        state = "inconclusive"
        if isinstance(low, (int, float)) and low >= threshold:
            state = "meets_margin"
        elif isinstance(high, (int, float)) and high < threshold:
            state = "fails_margin"
        outcomes.append(
            {
                "case": case,
                "state": state,
                "margin": threshold,
                "session_effects": effects,
                "interval": interval,
            }
        )
    quality = False
    if review is not None:
        record = object_fields(
            review,
            {
                "schema",
                "reviewer",
                "date",
                "policy_sha256",
                "results_sha256",
                "cases",
                "approved",
                "limitations",
            },
            "quality review",
        )
        for key in ("results_sha256", "cases"):
            items = record[key]
            if not isinstance(items, list) or not all(
                isinstance(item, str) for item in items
            ):
                raise ValueError("quality review requires string identities")
        quality = (
            record["schema"] == "shaderlod-quality-review-v1"
            and record["approved"] is True
            and bool(label(record["reviewer"], "reviewer"))
            and bool(label(record["date"], "date"))
            and record["policy_sha256"] == policy.identity
            and isinstance(record["results_sha256"], list)
            and set(result_hashes) <= set(record["results_sha256"])
            and isinstance(record["cases"], list)
            and set(policy.cases) <= set(record["cases"])
        )
    return {
        "schema": "shaderlod-qualification-assessment-v1",
        "policy_sha256": policy.identity,
        "cases": outcomes,
        "problems": problems,
        "quality_review_complete": quality,
        "recommendation": "meets_declared_policy"
        if quality
        and not problems
        and all(case["state"] == "meets_margin" for case in outcomes)
        else "do_not_promote",
        "limits": "Conditional on independent comparable sessions and declared coverage; no universal hardware/pack or perceptual claim; small samples remain inconclusive",
    }
